ic_device.name: NA555, NE555, SA555, SE555
ic_device.description: Precision timing circuits capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation.

pins.name: TRIG
pins.description: Start of timing input. TRIG < ½ CONT sets output high and discharge open

pins.name: RESET
pins.description: Active low reset input forces output and discharge low.

pins.name: CONT
pins.description: Controls comparator thresholds, outputs 2/3 × VCC, allows bypass capacitor connection

pins.name: THRES
pins.description: End of timing input. THRES > CONT sets output low and discharge low

pins.name: DISCH
pins.description: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor
pins.evidence: Open collector output to discharge timing capacitor

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V. SE555 maximum is 18V.

port_dependencies.condition: Ground return for the timer output.
Ground return for the discharge output.
TRIG below its trigger level sets the output high.
TRIG affects the timer latch and discharge state.
THRES above CONT sets the output low.
THRES above CONT sets discharge low.
Active low reset forces the output low.
Active low reset forces discharge low.

functional_blocks.name: Resistor divider
functional_blocks.description: Provides comparator threshold levels from VCC.

functional_blocks.name: Threshold Logic
functional_blocks.description: Threshold logic associated with the THRES input.

functional_blocks.name: Trigger Logic
functional_blocks.description: Trigger logic associated with the TRIG input.

functional_blocks.name: Latch
functional_blocks.description: Latch controlled by trigger, threshold, and reset.
